# Orbix Studio

> The supplied Orbix Studio pitch deck: 57 original slides covering the studio, services, selected work, team, engagements, and next steps.

This index describes this deck only. Text exports preserve the supplied source copy. 11 artwork slides have no extracted text and are explicitly marked visual-only; use their original images or the PDF. Figures and pricing belong to the supplied deck snapshot.

## Deck content

- [Full deck Markdown](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/deck.md>): Complete source copy, slide titles, sections, and stable links. Preferred starting point.
- [Structured deck JSON](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/data/deck.json>): All slide metadata and unmodified text, with textAvailability and source PDF pages.
- [Deck JSON Schema](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/data/deck.schema.json>): JSON Schema 2020-12 for the structured export.
- [Readable deck](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/read/>): Semantic HTML containing all slides without requiring JavaScript.
- [Full deck text](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/llms-full.txt>): Complete copy with provenance in a single text file.
- [Original deck PDF](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/assets/orbix-pitch-deck.pdf>): Original artwork and source material for visual-only slides.
- [Interactive slide viewer](<http://127.0.0.1:5188/>): Presentation with stable #slide-N links.
- [Original Figma source](<https://www.figma.com/design/W5FZYbLVrkrIdSb3kwpL94/Branding---Graphical-Elements?node-id=961-3139>): Design source supplied for this deck.
